Limit vibe coding

Modern AI has become far better at generating code. However, AI often generates insecure code. That has led to an explosion of vulnerable code being released. “Researchers at Georgia Tech’s Vibe Security Radar tracked CVEs directly attributable to AI coding tools and found that March 2026 alone produced more than all of 2025 combined.” [Holderhoff2026]

Where security matters, you need to have AI look for vulnerabilities and then have human review as well of AI-generated code. You can use AI to generate code. The problem happens if you trust that it’s infallible.
